details:
1. What Our Project Does

Our project is an interactive astronaut health and well-being platform designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. It integrates physical health monitoring, behavioral health assessments, and gamification into a single system, helping astronauts monitor their health, maintain healthy routines, and support one another throughout their missions.

The platform provides an interface where astronauts can track important health indicators, including heart rate, sleep patterns, mood, and stress levels. Through daily behavioral check-ins and personal journaling, users can also reflect on their psychological well-being and document changes in their emotional state.

Beyond conventional health monitoring, our platform introduces a virtual companion-based engagement system. Astronauts can care for, customize, and develop their own virtual companions by participating in daily wellness activities. A reward-based tracking system encourages consistent engagement through streaks, milestones, experience points, and virtual currency.

The platform also incorporates shared wellness goals, allowing crew members to participate in collective challenges and monitor shared achievements. By combining individual health management with interactive and collaborative features, our project aims to make astronaut well-being a more engaging and sustainable part of daily mission routines.

2. How it works - Key Features

2.1. Health Monitoring and Behavioral Assessment

The platform provides an accessible dashboard for astronauts to monitor important health indicators, including heart rate, sleep duration, mood, and stress levels.

  • Heart Rate Monitoring: Tracks heart rate measurements and presents changes over time to help astronauts recognize potential changes in their cardiovascular indicators. The system can highlight measurements that may require further attention.
  • Sleep Monitoring: Supports sleep tracking through wearable technology, such as NASA's Actiwatch research device, which uses movement and ambient-light measurements to support sleep assessment.
  • Daily Behavioral Check-ins: Provides short daily questionnaires that allow astronauts to record their mood, stress levels, and emotional well-being through accessible visual scales.
  • Health Data Visualization: Presents recorded indicators through dashboards and visual trends, helping astronauts understand changes in their health over time.

2.2. Reward-Based Tracking System

To encourage astronauts to participate consistently in daily health routines, our platform incorporates a gamified reward system based on streaks, milestones, and achievements.

  • Daily health check-ins and completed wellness activities contribute to participation streaks.
  • Astronauts earn experience points and virtual currency, referred to as Repoints, through consistent engagement.
  • Milestones unlock additional rewards and customization options.
  • Earned currency can be used to purchase virtual companion accessories, clothing, and habitat decorations.

This system draws on behavioral gamification principles: visualizing consecutive progress and providing achievable rewards can encourage users to maintain consistent participation. Rather than making health assessments feel like repetitive medical tasks, the system turns them into manageable daily activities.

2.3. Customizable Virtual Companion

Inspired by Tamagotchi and Pokémon, our platform introduces an interactive virtual companion that gives astronauts a more engaging way to participate in their daily wellness routines.

  • Astronauts can customize their companion's appearance, clothing, and accessories.
  • The companion develops through completed wellness activities and consistent participation.
  • Users can unlock new abilities, interactions, and customization options as they progress.
  • The companion's visual presentation can reflect wellness engagement and progress without serving as a medical diagnosis.

The virtual companion creates an additional layer of motivation by allowing astronauts to see the results of their participation through the development of something they actively care for.

2.4. Personal Digital Diary

The platform includes a personal digital diary designed to encourage emotional reflection and psychological self-awareness.

  • Astronauts are prompted to write a journal entry as part of their evening routine.
  • Entries allow users to document personal experiences, emotions, and reflections throughout the mission.
  • Regular journaling helps astronauts recognize patterns in their mood and emotional well-being.
  • Entries remain private by default, with sharing limited to individuals the user chooses.

This feature provides astronauts with a space for personal reflection, particularly during missions where isolation and confinement may affect psychological well-being.

2.5. Shared Goal-Setting and Crew Engagement

Recognizing that social connection is important during long-duration missions, our platform incorporates collaborative wellness features.

  • Astronauts can establish individual and shared wellness goals.
  • Crew members can participate in collective challenges and track shared achievements.
  • Progress toward common goals encourages cooperation and mutual accountability.
  • Shared achievements provide opportunities for positive reinforcement and social interaction.

By introducing collaborative activities, the platform aims to strengthen crew cohesion and make wellness routines a shared experience rather than an entirely individual responsibility.

2.6. Personalized Virtual Environment and Reward Shop

Each astronaut's virtual companion has its own customizable digital environment.

  • Users can personalize their companion's habitat with decorations and accessories.
  • New items can be unlocked through milestones and earned virtual currency.
  • The reward shop provides additional customization options, including clothing and environmental upgrades.
  • The virtual environment develops alongside the user's participation in wellness activities.

This creates a continuous progression system that gives astronauts additional reasons to return to the platform and engage with their daily routines.

3. Benefits and Intended Impact

Our platform addresses both the physical and psychological challenges of long-duration spaceflight by combining health awareness, behavioral support, and social engagement.

Improved Health Awareness: By organizing health indicators into accessible dashboards and visual trends, astronauts can monitor changes in their health and become more aware of potential concerns that may require further assessment.

Consistent Health Monitoring: Daily check-ins, reminders, streaks, and milestone rewards encourage astronauts to participate regularly in health assessments and wellness activities.

Psychological Well-being: Behavioral questionnaires and personal journaling provide opportunities for emotional reflection and self-awareness, helping astronauts keep track of their psychological well-being throughout a mission.

Increased Engagement: The virtual companion and reward system transform routine wellness activities into interactive experiences, potentially making consistent participation more engaging.

Stronger Crew Cohesion: Shared wellness goals and collaborative achievements encourage communication, cooperation, and mutual support among crew members.

4. Our Goals and Future Vision

Our ultimate goal is to make health management an integrated and sustainable part of everyday life during long-duration space missions. Rather than treating physical monitoring, psychological assessments, and social well-being as separate responsibilities, our platform brings them together through one accessible and engaging experience.

We hope to support astronauts in becoming more aware of their health, maintaining consistent wellness routines, and recognizing changes that may require additional attention from mission medical personnel. At the same time, we aim to make daily health management less isolating by introducing a virtual companion and collaborative crew activities.

As human space exploration progresses toward longer missions, including future journeys to the Moon and Mars, accessible self-monitoring and psychological support will become increasingly important. Our project envisions a future in which astronauts do not simply monitor their health, but actively engage with their well-being throughout the mission.
